# npm-integration tests that still fall back to QuickJS on main. CI runs these with
# THAW_JS_FALLBACK=warn; every other registry_add test runs with THAW_JS_FALLBACK=error,
# so a fallback there fails the test.
#
# Shrink only. Delete a line when its test stops falling back (the job summary lists
# such tests). Never add a line: a PR that adds one fails CI, so fix the test instead.
# One test function name per line, without the tests:: prefix. Sorted.
registry_add_builds_a_multi_package_project_when_enabled
registry_add_builds_real_pg_pool_when_enabled
registry_add_computes_and_formats_real_luxon_datetimes_when_enabled
registry_add_delivers_real_read_stream_data_to_an_inline_callback_literal_when_enabled
registry_add_exposes_real_undici_named_exports_when_enabled
registry_add_fetches_and_runs_node_rs_crc32_when_enabled
registry_add_renders_and_compiles_ejs_templates_end_to_end_when_enabled
registry_add_runs_a_real_express_route_when_enabled
registry_add_runs_a_real_hapi_route_when_enabled
registry_add_runs_express_continuously_for_a_short_window_when_enabled
